hypotheses.note: not a plain outage; the failure is load-shaped, see H-006

hypotheses.discriminating_test: 5 other production-side roles probed UP in the same run

availability_probe_burst.note: the probe issues 15 role probes at the 0.9s global-throttle floor; implementer-i12 fails in that burst every time

upstream_error: litellm.ServiceUnavailableError: OpenAIException - Service temporarily unavailable. Received Model Group=gpt-5.6-luna, Available Model Group Fallbacks=None

the global throttle's 0.9s floor is account-wide and correct; it is too fast for this one channel
